rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time interval
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A temporal entity with an extent or duration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time interval
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A region in a dimensional space that aims at representing time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Time-indexed Value in Context pattern
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Silvio Peroni (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Time-indexed Value in Context pattern
rdf:Description.vann:changes: * **v1.1.0**: Added new documentation, including annotation properties (e.g., `bibo:doi`, `schema:codeRepository`, etc.), term properties (e.g., `vann:example`, `vs:term_status`, etc.), exemplary competency questions with their respective SPARQL queries, and a Grafoo diagram.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: at time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a value-in-time situation and the particular temporal instant or time period in which the situation takes place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: value in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular kind of time-indexed situation that represents a hub linking the entity having a particular value, the value itself and the temporal and contextual extents from which the entity-value relationship depends.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Example: having the role "graduate student" in a specific time (e.g., now) and context (e.g., "University of Bologna").

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: for entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and an entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: within context
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the specific context within which the fact of the entity having the value is relevant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time instant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A temporal entity with zero extent or duration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity (e.g., a person) and a particular value-in-time situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the value held by the entity taking part to the value-in-time situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A view on a set of entities. It can be seen as a 'relational context', reifying a relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has time indexed setting
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and a time-indexed situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is setting for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a situation and an entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: at time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and a time interval.
